facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: kinetic release during cleaning and preparation on P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-3221 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-3221 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 18 December 2024 an incident occurred on P-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
